## W24A Monitoring and ninety-day actions

Done when: every indicator has a threshold, recipient, alternate and response time; each period has actions with owners and acceptance evidence; and review dates are set with a chair and decision authority.

Confirm that the owner can act on the alert within the agreed tolerance. Recurring governance effort belongs in the business-value calculation. Assign broader institutional gaps even when they exceed this engagement.
